subject: How to identify long branches removed by geom_point_g_tree?

messages.author: 0e0d0599915fa5c9
messages.subject: How to identify long branches removed by geom_point_g_tree?
parts:
Hello Yu Lab-
Thank you for the treedataverse package. I am a new user and have built a handful of trees.

Currently, I am running into an issue with some of the large trees I am building. These larger trees will generate a warning message: ex.  Warning: Removed ## rows containing missing values (geom_point_g_gtree).  
I looked into these warning messages, and it appears your Frequently Asked Question A.5.3 (http://yulab-smu.top/treedata-book/faq.html#shrink-outlier-long-branch) addresses this issue, and I need to reduce the branch length of the long branches that are getting removed in my trees.

Now to my question, how does a person determine the branch ID of long branches getting removed? In your Figure A.8 (http://yulab-smu.top/treedata-book/faq.html#shrink-outlier-long-branch) branch 75 and 76 are shortened, but in the large trees I am generating, the long branches are being removed before my tree is printed, so I have no way of knowing which branch IDs I need to specifically list to be read back in.

My specific tree that I am trying to fix:
code:
ggtree(tibble_joined_0023) + geom_treescale(y=-6, color='black', width = 1) + geom_tiplab(aes(color=Metagenome), size=1.2) + ggplot2::xlim(0, 3.5) + geom_tippoint(aes(color=Metagenome)) + ggtitle("Ch.Exp_NCVOG0023-D5-like helicase-primase")

resulting tree screen shot attached.

Any advice on how to handle this would be appreciated.
Thank you,
Anne
